name: Portuguese City of Mazagan (El Jadida)
description: On Morocco's Atlantic coast, about 90 km southwest of Casablanca, Mazagan is a walled Portuguese fortress town built in the early 1500s as a stop on the sea route to India. You can walk along its bastioned ramparts and visit the Church of the Assumption, with its late Gothic Manueline style. Beneath the citadel lies the vaulted Portuguese Cistern, a highlight of the old town.
